title: U.S. and China Reach ‘Framework’ for a TikTok Sale
summary: Top economic officials met in Madrid for a second day, with deadlines looming on tariffs and a ban on TikTok in the United States if it is not sold by its Chinese owner, ByteDance.

title: Who is Fed nominee Stephen Miran, and why is he so controversial?
summary: Stephen Miran, who has served in both Trump administrations, said he will not resign from the White House if confirmed to the Federal Reserve Board, further stoking concerns about its independence.

title: Brazilians split after ex-President Jair Bolsonaro’s conviction
summary: For some, the 27-year sentence handed to the former president for attempted coup is justice - for others, tragedy.
